name: vex_tm
description: VEX Tournament Manager audience-display / OBS overlay (common at regional and college events, incl. many VEXU streams). Match label + number top-left of the header bar, clock top-right, alliance panels in the bottom corners. Note: some events run this overlay with a frozen clock, so Scout Hub falls back to detecting the match-number label. Tune the rectangles + re-process for a specific event.
